project.name: dotfiles
project.description: Personal Linux/Unix dotfiles for Arch, Manjaro, Ubuntu, and macOS, managed via GNU Stow. This analysis is scoped to the repo operations backbone: OS bootstrap/provisioning scripts, helper utilities, the GNU Make stow lifecycle, GitHub Actions CI, and project docs.

nodes.name: check-workspace-parity.yml
nodes.summary: CI workflow that checks out this repo and its peer (dotfiles ↔ WinDotfiles) and asserts the shared cuberhaus-workspace/ directory is byte-identical, failing on any drift (excluding sync.sh/sync.ps1/README.md/repos.json).

nodes.name: lint.yml
nodes.summary: CI workflow with three jobs: ShellCheck via .local/scripts/lint.sh, a scan rejecting hardcoded /home/<user> and /Users/<user> paths in tracked files, and a stow dry-run (make dry-run) into a scratch HOME.

nodes.name: markdown.yml
nodes.summary: CI workflow that runs markdownlint-cli2 against the repo's own Markdown files (README.md, .local/README.md, wallpapers README) on changes to *.md files.

nodes.name: secrets.yml
nodes.summary: CI workflow that runs gitleaks over the full git history on push, pull request, and a weekly schedule to detect committed secrets.

nodes.name: skills-update.yml
nodes.summary: Scheduled monthly workflow that runs npx skills update to refresh pinned agent skills, then opens (and auto-merges) a pull request when skills-lock.json changes.

nodes.name: vim.yml
nodes.summary: CI workflow that lints .vim/vimrc with vint and verifies it loads in Vim's ex mode without errors when the vimrc file changes.

nodes.name: xmonad.yml
nodes.summary: CI workflow that sets up Haskell and XMonad libraries and compiles .xmonad/xmonad.hs with ghc -fno-code to verify the window-manager config builds when it changes.

nodes.name: dependabot.yml
nodes.summary: Dependabot v2 config that opens weekly dependency-bump PRs against main, grouping git submodule and github-actions updates into a single multi-ecosystem group so they land as one PR per week.

nodes.name: FUNDING.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub sponsor metadata declaring funding platforms (GitHub Sponsors and Buy Me a Coffee) for the cuberhaus account.

nodes.name: pull_request_template.md
nodes.summary: Pull request template documenting the contribution process with Summary, Type of change, Checklist, and Notes-for-reviewers sections, prompting contributors to update AGENTS.md and avoid committing secrets.

nodes.name: doctor.sh
nodes.summary: Bash health-check run via `make doctor` that verifies required CLI tools (stow, git, shellcheck, markdownlint-cli2, vint) are installed and scans $HOME for broken symlinks. Exits non-zero when any tool is missing.

nodes.name: lint.sh
nodes.summary: Lints all tracked shell scripts in the repo with shellcheck; sources lint_helpers.sh to enumerate the script list and exits non-zero if any warnings are reported.

nodes.name: lint_helpers.sh
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for shell-lint file patterns, vendored-path exclusions, and hardcoded-path rules shared by lint.sh, the pre-commit hook, and CI. Exposes lint_get_scripts to list tracked shell scripts.

nodes.name: permanent_shutdown_fix.sh
nodes.summary: Idempotently patches /etc/default/grub with power-management and graphics kernel parameters and removes 'quiet splash' for verbose shutdown logging, backing up the config and running update-grub.

nodes.name: pipewire.sh
nodes.summary: i3blocks audio block that displays the default sink's device, volume, and mute status and supports cycling the default playback device, toggling mute, and adjusting volume via pactl and amixer.

nodes.name: ycm.sh
nodes.summary: Installs YouCompleteMe and its build dependencies for the detected OS/distro (Arch, Ubuntu, macOS, Manjaro) and compiles ycm_core, cleaning up the temporary build directory afterward.

nodes.name: lint_get_scripts
nodes.summary: Lists all git-tracked shell scripts matching LINT_PATTERNS while filtering out vendored and submodule paths via LINT_EXCLUDES; consumed by lint.sh and the pre-commit hook.

nodes.name: set_default_playback_device_next
nodes.summary: Cycles the default PulseAudio/PipeWire sink forward or backward by the given increment and migrates active sink inputs to the new default device.

nodes.name: print_block
nodes.summary: Builds the i3blocks output for the running sink by resolving its name, volume, and mute state, then emits the formatted long/short text plus the status color.

nodes.name: ubuntu_based_install
nodes.summary: Installs the apt build dependencies (compilers, JDK, Go, mono, node, python) required to compile YouCompleteMe on Ubuntu-based systems.

nodes.name: ycm_install
nodes.summary: Builds ycm_core with cmake and runs YouCompleteMe's install.py with all completers, then cleans up the temporary build directory.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Central task orchestrator wrapping GNU Stow for the dotfiles symlink lifecycle (install/uninstall/restow/dry-run) plus quality (lint/check/fix/doctor), git hooks, skills, workspace sync, submodules, and per-OS bootstrap/uninstall targets. Each target delegates to a `.local/scripts` helper, `stow`, or an OS bootstrap entrypoint.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent-facing guide describing the dotfiles architecture (nested stow layout, `$DOTFILES`, bootstrap segregation), build/test commands via make, bash conventions, installed agent skills, pitfalls, and the cuberhaus-workspace multi-root integration.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Primary project README explaining the `dotfiles/dotfiles` GNU Stow layout, installation, make-based usage, volatile config handling, per-OS bootstrap flow, the tooling inventory, and supported operating systems and window managers.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: Security policy covering vulnerability reporting plus considerations for reviewing scripts before running, sudo privilege-escalation awareness, GPG commit verification, and keeping sensitive data out of the dotfiles repo.

nodes.name: applets
nodes.summary: Interactive installer that downloads a curated set of Cinnamon applets/desklets from the Linux Mint spices site in parallel and extracts them into the user's local Cinnamon applets directory. Includes a generic ex() archive-extraction helper.

nodes.name: changeBrightness
nodes.summary: Adjusts laptop backlight brightness via `light` by a signed integer step and shows a dunst notification with a progress bar. Validates the numeric argument and checks for required commands.

nodes.name: changeVolume
nodes.summary: Sets or adjusts the default sink volume via pactl, queries amixer for the current level/mute state, and displays a dunst notification (muted or with a volume bar). Refreshes i3blocks after changes.

nodes.name: clone-all
nodes.summary: Clones every repository in a GitHub org (via gh) or fast-forwards the ones already present, running per-repo work in parallel with xargs and printing one colored status line per repo.

nodes.name: git-ahead
nodes.summary: Scans all git repos under a directory, optionally fetches all remotes, and reports any remote branch with commits ahead of the detected base (origin/HEAD, main, or master). Color-coded output, configurable depth.

nodes.name: git-clean-branches
nodes.summary: Scans git repos under a directory and safely deletes local branches that have no remote tracking branch and no commits ahead of the default branch, using `git branch -d`. Supports dry-run and depth options.

nodes.name: git-recurse
nodes.summary: Runs an arbitrary git command across all repositories found under the current directory up to a configurable depth, optionally in parallel with grouped per-repo output. Includes a macOS ssh-key helper.

nodes.name: pfetch
nodes.summary: Vendored POSIX sh system-information fetch tool (neofetch-style) that prints distro ASCII art alongside OS, kernel, uptime, packages, memory and other details via dozens of internal getter functions.

nodes.name: program
nodes.summary: Launcher that uses wmctrl to focus an existing window of a program if one is open, otherwise starts a new instance. Accepts an optional second argument for the window class to match.

nodes.name: prompt
nodes.summary: Tiny helper that prints `user@host` with the username colored red and the hostname green using tput. Used as a minimal prompt/identity display.

nodes.name: yolo
nodes.summary: Three-line convenience script that stages all changes, commits with a placeholder message, and pushes. A quick throwaway-commit helper.

nodes.name: arch
nodes.summary: Arch Linux bootstrap entrypoint. Sources base_functions and arch_functions, updates the system, then orchestrates the full install sequence (base, arch drivers, i3, xmonad, AUR apps, vim, AI tools) and sets zsh as the default shell.

nodes.name: arch_functions
nodes.summary: Large library of Arch/Manjaro install functions sourced by the arch and manjaro entrypoints: base packages, AUR/yay setup, window managers (i3, xmonad), desktop environments, vim, emacs, AI tools, games and optional extras.

nodes.name: base_functions
nodes.summary: Shared bootstrap library sourced by every OS entrypoint. Provides logging helpers (info/warn/error), XDG defaults, environment preparation, NVIDIA anti-tearing/FreeSync display config, and skip-worktree handling for volatile config files.

nodes.name: mac
nodes.summary: macOS bootstrap entrypoint. Sources base_functions and mac_functions, then runs install preparation, Homebrew install, the macOS package set, AI tools and vim before applying skip-worktree.

nodes.name: mac_functions
nodes.summary: Library of macOS install functions sourced by the mac entrypoint: Homebrew bootstrap, the main brew bundle (mac_install), AI tools, vim, Doom Emacs, App Store apps, and an extensive `defaults write` system-preferences configurator.

nodes.name: manjaro
nodes.summary: Manjaro bootstrap entrypoint. Sources base_functions and arch_functions, updates the system, then runs the shared Arch/Manjaro install path plus Manjaro-specific packages, window managers, laptop tweaks and vim.

nodes.name: ubuntu
nodes.summary: Ubuntu bootstrap entrypoint. Sources base_functions and ubuntu_functions, runs apt update/upgrade, then orchestrates brew, base packages, emacs, repo cloning, Chrome, snaps, NVIDIA config, AI tools and vim.

nodes.name: ubuntu_functions
nodes.summary: Library of Ubuntu install functions sourced by the ubuntu and ubuntu_windows entrypoints: base packages, apt/snap/Chrome/emacs installs, i3, AI tools, vim, repo cloning, high-DPI and touchpad tweaks, and WSL windows_install.

nodes.name: ubuntu_windows
nodes.summary: WSL (Ubuntu-on-Windows) bootstrap entrypoint. Sources ubuntu_functions and base_functions, updates apt, installs brew, base packages, vim and the WSL-specific windows_install set, then switches the shell to zsh.

nodes.name: uninstall_arch
nodes.summary: Arch uninstall entrypoint. Sources base_functions, the uninstall_tui menu and uninstall_arch_functions, then presents a checklist of uninstall actions (base, drivers, i3, xmonad, vim, laptop, dwall, papirus, emacs).

nodes.name: uninstall_arch_functions
nodes.summary: Library of Arch/Manjaro uninstall functions (base, arch drivers, i3, xmonad, vim, laptop, dwall, papirus, emacs) sourced by the uninstall_arch and uninstall_manjaro entrypoints.

nodes.name: uninstall_mac
nodes.summary: macOS uninstall entrypoint. Sources base_functions, uninstall_tui and uninstall_mac_functions, then offers a checklist to remove CLI tools, Nerd Fonts, GUI apps, vim, and run brew cleanup.

nodes.name: uninstall_mac_functions
nodes.summary: Library of macOS uninstall functions sourced by the uninstall_mac entrypoint: remove CLI tools, Nerd Fonts, GUI applications, vim/neovim, and a brew cleanup helper.

nodes.name: uninstall_manjaro
nodes.summary: Manjaro uninstall entrypoint. Sources base_functions, uninstall_tui, uninstall_arch_functions and uninstall_manjaro_functions, then presents a checklist combining shared Arch and Manjaro-specific uninstall actions.

nodes.name: process_repo
nodes.summary: Handles a single repository: pulls with --ff-only if it is already a git repo, skips non-repo paths, or clones it fresh via gh, emitting a colored status label and indented error output.

nodes.name: scan_repo
nodes.summary: For one repo, optionally fetches all remotes, detects the base branch, and iterates every remote branch counting commits ahead of the base, printing only branches that are ahead.

nodes.name: scan_repo
nodes.summary: For one repo, detects the default branch and iterates local branches, deleting (or previewing) those with no remote tracking branch and zero commits ahead of the default. Returns the deletion count.

nodes.name: git_recursive
nodes.summary: Core engine of git-recurse: finds all .git dirs up to a depth and runs the given command in each, either sequentially with pushd/popd or in parallel with per-repo temp logs, summarizing successes and failures.

nodes.name: install_preparation
nodes.summary: Prepares the environment before installation: writes a default vim theme, creates and chowns vim/zsh/vlc cache directories, touches viminfo files, and creates the Samba usershares directory.

nodes.name: nvidia_display_config
nodes.summary: Writes an Xorg NVIDIA config to eliminate screen tearing, choosing between ForceFullCompositionPipeline (HDMI) and FreeSync/G-Sync-compatible mode (DisplayPort). Skips silently if no NVIDIA driver is present.

nodes.name: apply_skip_worktree
nodes.summary: Applies git update-index --skip-worktree to volatile, app-rewritten config files (Warp prefs, LibreOffice settings) so they stay tracked but silence runtime noise. Skips files not yet present.

nodes.name: base_install
nodes.summary: Installs the large core package set common to Arch/Manjaro (CLI tools, fonts, dev tooling, fzf, kitty, etc.) via pacman, configuring services and base utilities used across the dotfiles.

nodes.name: git_repos
nodes.summary: Clones the user's personal git repositories into the expected locations during Arch/Manjaro bootstrap.

nodes.name: arch_install
nodes.summary: Installs Arch-specific drivers and services (NVIDIA, CUPS printing, Bluetooth) and related configuration during bootstrap.

nodes.name: arch_and_manjaro
nodes.summary: Installs configuration shared between Arch and Manjaro (printers, Samba and similar) invoked by both entrypoints.

nodes.name: manjaro_install
nodes.summary: Installs Manjaro-specific packages and tweaks (IDEs, snaps, Spotify and other extras) called from the manjaro entrypoint.

nodes.name: yay_install
nodes.summary: Bootstraps the yay AUR helper by cloning and building it so that AUR packages can be installed later in the bootstrap.

nodes.name: vim_install
nodes.summary: Installs Vim/Neovim extras and supporting tooling (ctags, formatters, language servers) and bootstraps plugin setup on Arch/Manjaro.

nodes.name: i3_install
nodes.summary: Installs the i3 window-manager stack (i3-gaps, i3blocks, rofi and related utilities) and its configuration during Arch/Manjaro bootstrap.

nodes.name: xmonad_install
nodes.summary: Installs the xmonad window manager and companion tools (xmobar, trayer, dmenu) during Arch/Manjaro bootstrap.

nodes.name: cinnamon_install
nodes.summary: Installs the Cinnamon desktop environment and its dependencies during Arch/Manjaro bootstrap.

nodes.name: emacs
nodes.summary: Installs Emacs and bootstraps the Doom Emacs configuration during Arch/Manjaro setup.

nodes.name: ai_tools_install
nodes.summary: Installs AI/LLM CLI tooling (such as Claude/Copilot helpers and supporting Node/npm packages) during Arch/Manjaro bootstrap.

nodes.name: optional
nodes.summary: Large catch-all of optional, manually-invoked Arch/Manjaro install snippets and extras not run by default during the standard bootstrap.

nodes.name: base_install
nodes.summary: Installs the core Ubuntu package set via apt (CLI tools, dev tooling and utilities) that underpins the rest of the dotfiles setup.

nodes.name: ubuntu_install
nodes.summary: Installs Ubuntu-specific applications and configuration (GUI apps, desktop tweaks and extra packages) during bootstrap.

nodes.name: chrome_install
nodes.summary: Downloads and installs Google Chrome from the official .deb package on Ubuntu.

nodes.name: emacs_install
nodes.summary: Installs Emacs and bootstraps the Doom Emacs configuration on Ubuntu.

nodes.name: i3_install
nodes.summary: Installs and configures the i3 window-manager stack on Ubuntu, building components that require manual input where needed.

nodes.name: snaps_install
nodes.summary: Installs the default set of snap packages on Ubuntu during bootstrap.

nodes.name: ai_tools_install
nodes.summary: Installs AI/LLM CLI tooling and supporting Node/npm packages on Ubuntu during bootstrap.

nodes.name: vim_install
nodes.summary: Installs Vim/Neovim and supporting tooling (ctags, formatters) and bootstraps plugins on Ubuntu.

nodes.name: clone_repos
nodes.summary: Clones the user's personal git repositories into their expected locations during Ubuntu bootstrap.

nodes.name: high_dpi_screen
nodes.summary: Applies high-DPI display scaling tweaks for Ubuntu on high-resolution screens.

nodes.name: brew_install
nodes.summary: Bootstraps Homebrew on macOS if it is not already installed, the prerequisite for all subsequent brew-based installs.

nodes.name: mac_install
nodes.summary: Installs the main macOS package set via Homebrew (CLI tools, fonts, casks and GUI applications) that forms the core of the macOS environment.

nodes.name: ai_tools_install
nodes.summary: Installs AI/LLM CLI tooling and supporting packages on macOS during bootstrap.

nodes.name: optional
nodes.summary: Collection of optional, manually-invoked macOS install snippets and extras not run during the default bootstrap.

nodes.name: vim_install
nodes.summary: Installs macvim/neovim and supporting tooling and bootstraps vim plugins on macOS.

nodes.name: doom_emacs_install
nodes.summary: Installs Emacs and bootstraps the Doom Emacs configuration on macOS.

nodes.name: app_store_install
nodes.summary: Installs Mac App Store applications via the mas CLI during macOS bootstrap.

nodes.name: write_defaults
nodes.summary: Extensive `defaults write` configurator that tunes macOS system and application preferences (Dock, Finder, keyboard, trackpad and more) to the user's opinionated settings.

nodes.name: base_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes the core base package set (cmake, bat, fzf, kitty, vim and similar) installed by the Arch/Manjaro base_install.

nodes.name: arch_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes Arch-specific drivers and services (NVIDIA, CUPS, Bluetooth) installed during bootstrap.

nodes.name: i3_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes the i3 window-manager stack (i3-gaps, i3blocks, rofi and related packages).

nodes.name: xmonad_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes the xmonad window manager and companion tools (xmobar, trayer, dmenu).

nodes.name: vim_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes Vim/Neovim extras (ctags, formatters and related tooling) installed during Arch/Manjaro bootstrap.

nodes.name: emacs_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes Emacs and the Doom Emacs configuration installed during Arch/Manjaro bootstrap.

nodes.name: cli_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes the macOS CLI tools installed via Homebrew (bat, fzf, ripgrep, stow and similar).

nodes.name: fonts_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes the Nerd Fonts (Fira Code, Iosevka, Meslo and others) installed via Homebrew on macOS.

nodes.name: gui_apps_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes the GUI applications (Chrome, Spotify, VS Code and similar) installed as Homebrew casks on macOS.

nodes.name: vim_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes macvim/neovim and associated plugins installed during macOS bootstrap.

nodes.name: uninstall_manjaro_functions
nodes.summary: Manjaro uninstall helper functions that remove Manjaro-specific snaps/pacman packages and shared Arch+Manjaro packages (printer drivers, samba group, git credential helper).

nodes.name: uninstall_tui
nodes.summary: Reusable TUI checklist helper sourced by the per-OS uninstall entrypoints; renders a whiptail/dialog/plain-text checkbox list and invokes each selected component as a bash function after confirmation.

nodes.name: uninstall_ubuntu
nodes.summary: Ubuntu uninstall entrypoint that sources base_functions, the TUI helper, and the Ubuntu uninstall functions, then presents a checklist of removable components (base packages, GUI apps, snaps, Emacs, Vim, Homebrew, cleanup).

nodes.name: uninstall_ubuntu_functions
nodes.summary: Ubuntu uninstall function library defining per-component removers (base packages, GUI apps, Chrome, snaps, Emacs, Vim/Neovim, Homebrew) plus an apt autoremove cleanup.

nodes.name: uninstall_work
nodes.summary: Work machine (ROG Strix/Ubuntu+NVIDIA) uninstall entrypoint that sources base_functions, the TUI helper, and the work uninstall functions, then offers a checklist to remove NVIDIA, dev tools, Node, Python, Docker, and GUI apps.

nodes.name: uninstall_work_functions
nodes.summary: Work machine uninstall function library that reverses the work bootstrap: removes NVIDIA tools, dev tools, Node, Python/pipx, Docker CE, and GUI apps including repo keys and snaps.

nodes.name: work
nodes.summary: Work machine bootstrap entrypoint (Asus ROG Strix / Ubuntu + NVIDIA) that sources base_functions and work_functions, then runs the full install sequence: shutdown fix, NVIDIA, dev tools, Node, Python, Docker, gcloud, and GUI apps.

nodes.name: work_functions
nodes.summary: Large work-machine bootstrap function library installing NVIDIA drivers, core dev tools, Node.js, Python, Docker CE, Google Cloud SDK, and a wide range of GUI/AI applications with parallel downloads and high-DPI tweaks.

nodes.name: cinnamon_dump_config
nodes.summary: Cinnamon config dumper that snapshots /org/cinnamon, /org/nemo, /org/gtk, and /org/gnome dconf trees into light or dark profile files, selected via -l/-d getopts flags.

nodes.name: cinnamon_load_config
nodes.summary: Cinnamon config loader that restores saved light or dark dconf profiles into /org/cinnamon, /org/nemo, /org/gtk, and /org/gnome, selected via -l/-d getopts flags.

nodes.name: dark-theme
nodes.summary: Applies the Cinnamon dark theme by dconf-loading the saved dark profiles, switching Papirus folder colors, and setting the base16 onedark terminal scheme.

nodes.name: light-theme
nodes.summary: Applies the Cinnamon light theme by dconf-loading the saved light profiles, switching Papirus folder colors, and setting a base16 light terminal scheme.

nodes.name: gnome_dump_config
nodes.summary: One-line GNOME config dumper that exports the entire dconf database to ~/.config/dconf-settings.ini.

nodes.name: gnome_load_config
nodes.summary: One-line GNOME config loader that imports the entire dconf database from ~/.config/dconf-settings.ini.

nodes.name: claude-cost-stats.py
nodes.summary: CLI tool that scans Claude Code/agent JSONL transcripts, computes token usage and per-model/per-group cost using a built-in rates table, and prints a humanized cost summary with optional --since filtering and JSON output.

nodes.name: discord_fix.py
nodes.summary: Tiny script that edits ~/.config/discord/settings.json to set SKIP_HOST_UPDATE=true, preventing Discord's broken self-updater from running.

nodes.name: desklets
nodes.summary: Interactive installer that optionally downloads Cinnamon calendar and diskspace desklets in parallel and extracts them via a built-in multi-format ex() helper.

nodes.name: pre-commit
nodes.summary: Git pre-commit hook that mirrors CI locally on staged files: shellcheck on staged shell scripts, hardcoded-user-path scanning, and markdownlint on staged markdown, sourcing shared helpers from lint_helpers.sh.

nodes.name: obsidian-reinstall-plugins
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper that locates the canonical obsidian-reinstall-plugins script inside the obsidian_vault repo and re-execs it, printing clone instructions if the vault is missing.

nodes.name: spot
nodes.summary: Status-bar helper that prints the currently playing Spotify artist and song via playerctl when Spotify is running.

nodes.name: spoti
nodes.summary: Status-bar helper that resolves the Spotify window title via wmctrl/pgrep to display the current track, used where playerctl is unavailable.

nodes.name: stow-backup-conflicts
nodes.summary: Runs a GNU Stow dry-run, parses conflicting non-symlink targets, and moves each into a timestamped ~/.dotfiles-backup directory so stow can proceed cleanly.

nodes.name: stow-uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes all stow symlinks and restores original files: detects unstow conflicts, moves them aside, runs stow -D, puts overwritten user data back, restores remaining backed-up files, and cleans up the backup directory.

nodes.name: toggle_theme
nodes.summary: Self-contained light/dark theme switcher that updates GTK 2/3 theme and icon settings, Vim colorscheme, termite colors, and wallpaper based on a single light|dark argument.

nodes.name: volume-change-output
nodes.summary: Helper that auto-detects the ALSA/PulseAudio mixer and simple control name (defaulting to the pulse device) for use in volume-control keybindings.

nodes.name: nvidia_install
nodes.summary: Installs ubuntu-drivers-common and NVIDIA drivers (via ubuntu-drivers install when no driver is loaded) plus nvidia-settings and nvidia-prime for Optimus GPU switching.

nodes.name: dev_tools_install
nodes.summary: Installs a broad set of core dev tools and modern CLI utilities (build-essential, git, zsh, neovim, bat, eza, fzf, ripgrep, etc.) and configures the git credential helper.

nodes.name: node_install
nodes.summary: Installs Node.js 22 LTS via the NodeSource setup script and adds global npm packages (cline, markdownlint-cli2, GitHub Copilot CLI) if missing.

nodes.name: python_install
nodes.summary: Installs Python 3 with pip, venv, and pipx, ensures the pipx path, and installs the vim-vint linter used for the vimrc.

nodes.name: docker_install
nodes.summary: Installs Docker CE from the official apt repo (GPG key, sources list, buildx/compose plugins) and adds the current user to the docker group for rootless usage.

nodes.name: gcloud_install
nodes.summary: Downloads and installs the Google Cloud CLI tarball into the home directory and runs its quiet installer when gcloud is not already present.

nodes.name: gui_apps_install
nodes.summary: Phased GUI/AI app installer that downloads .deb/.AppImage/.run files in parallel then installs Chrome, Warp, LM Studio, Cursor, GPT4All, VS Code, Obsidian, Antigravity, Ollama, Zed, Claude Code, and assorted snaps.

nodes.name: high_dpi_screen
nodes.summary: Applies GNOME high-DPI tweaks by increasing text-scaling-factor, cursor size, and desktop icon size instead of using full or fractional scaling.

nodes.name: dev_tools_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes the core dev tools and CLI utilities installed by the work bootstrap and unsets the global git credential helper.

nodes.name: node_uninstall
nodes.summary: Uninstalls global npm packages and the nodejs package, then removes the NodeSource apt repo and key.

nodes.name: python_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes Python 3, pip, venv, and pipx, uninstalls vim-vint, and clears all pipx-installed packages.

nodes.name: docker_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes Docker CE and its plugins, deletes the Docker apt repo and GPG key, and removes the user from the docker group.

nodes.name: gui_apps_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes the work GUI apps installed via apt and snap (Chrome, VS Code, Antigravity, Warp, Obsidian, Spotify, etc.), deletes their repos/keys and the Cursor AppImage, then runs apt autoremove.

nodes.name: base_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes the Ubuntu base package set (build tools, git, gh, zsh, neovim, tmux, ranger, etc.) and unsets the global git credential helper.

nodes.name: ubuntu_gui_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes Ubuntu GUI packages (lxappearance, audacity, calibre, KVM/libvirt, gparted, VLC, etc.) and removes RStudio via dpkg.

nodes.name: snaps_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes the snap packages installed by the Ubuntu bootstrap (VS Code, Discord, IntelliJ, PyCharm, Skype, Slack, Spotify, Sublime, Walc).

nodes.name: emacs_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes Emacs and its build deps and deletes Doom/Chemacs config directories under the home folder.

nodes.name: brew_uninstall
nodes.summary: Uninstalls Homebrew via the official uninstall script when the brew command is present, otherwise skips.

nodes.name: manjaro_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes Manjaro-specific snaps (IntelliJ, PyCharm, Spotify, Sublime, WhatsApp, Zotero) and pacman packages cinnamon-screensaver and manjaro-pipewire.

nodes.name: arch_and_manjaro_uninstall
nodes.summary: Removes packages shared by Arch and Manjaro (hplip and the Epson inkjet AUR driver), removes the user from the sambashare group, and unsets the git credential helper.

nodes.name: parse_since
nodes.summary: Parses a --since specification into a timezone-aware cutoff datetime, supporting relative durations (e.g. 7d, 24h) and absolute ISO dates, exiting on invalid input.

nodes.name: cost_for
nodes.summary: Computes the USD cost of a single usage record by applying per-token input/output and cache read/write rates from the given rates table.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entrypoint that parses CLI args, walks transcript JSONL events filtering by --since, aggregates tokens and cost by model and group, and prints a humanized summary or JSON report.

layers.name: OS Provisioning
layers.description: Per-OS bootstrap install scripts and their function libraries that set up a fresh machine (Arch, Manjaro, Ubuntu, macOS, work). Entry points source a shared base plus an OS-specific function file.

layers.name: System Teardown
layers.description: Uninstall counterparts to the provisioning layer, including an interactive TUI checklist, that remove packages and revert machine setup per OS.

layers.name: Stow & Repo Lifecycle
layers.description: GNU Make + GNU Stow lifecycle: the Makefile orchestrates symlink install/uninstall/restow, conflict backup, and the git pre-commit hook.

layers.name: Developer Utilities
layers.description: Command-line helpers for git workflows, repo cloning, shell prompt, system info, and Claude usage cost reporting.

layers.name: Desktop & Theming

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start here. The README explains that this repo is a GNU Stow-managed set of Linux/macOS dotfiles; AGENTS.md captures the conventions and architecture that agents and contributors must follow.

tour.title: The Stow Lifecycle
tour.description: The Makefile is the single entry point for everyday operations: it symlinks configs into $HOME via Stow, backs up conflicts first, and exposes install/uninstall/restow targets.

tour.title: OS Provisioning Entry Points
tour.description: Each supported OS has a bootstrap entry script. They source a shared base library plus an OS-specific function file, then run the install pipeline for that platform.

tour.title: Shared & Per-OS Function Libraries
tour.description: The real provisioning logic lives in function libraries: base_functions is shared by every OS, while arch/ubuntu/mac/work_functions add platform-specific package installs and setup steps.

tour.title: Tearing It Down
tour.description: Teardown mirrors provisioning. An interactive TUI checklist drives the per-OS uninstall entry points, which source matching uninstall function libraries to remove what was installed.

tour.title: Developer Utilities
tour.description: Day-to-day command-line helpers: bulk-clone repos, recurse git commands across many checkouts, prune merged branches, and report Claude token usage costs.

tour.title: Desktop & Theming
tour.description: Desktop environment management: dump and restore Cinnamon configuration, and switch the whole system between light and dark themes via a single toggle.

tour.title: Quality Gates
tour.description: Before code lands, the git pre-commit hook runs the lint suite (shellcheck via lint.sh + helpers) and the doctor health check verifies the environment.

tour.title: Continuous Integration
tour.description: GitHub Actions enforce the same checks remotely: linting, markdown rules, secret scanning, and workspace parity between the dotfiles and the cuberhaus workspace.

tour.title: Contributing & Security
tour.description: Finish with the contribution surface: the pull-request template, dependency automation via Dependabot, and the security policy.
